%%spark

import scala.util.Random
import java.time.Instant
import java.util.UUID

val aDynamic = s"""{"itemid":"X-Wing-${Random.nextInt()}" , "price": ${Random.nextInt()},"quantity": ${Random.nextInt()}""" //s"""{"itemid":  , "in_stock": true,"price": ${Random.nextInt()},"quantity": 23 }"""

val data = 1 to 100000 map(x =>  (Random.nextBoolean(), Instant.now().toString() , aDynamic ,UUID.randomUUID().toString() ,Random.nextInt(),Random.nextLong(),Random.nextDouble(),Random.nextString(5),123456789.12345678910d))

val allTypesDf = spark.sqlContext.createDataFrame(data).toDF("BoolType", "DateTimeType", "DynamicType","GuidType", "IntType", "LongType","RealType","StringType","DecimalType")
//(BoolType:bool,DateTimeType:datetime,DynamicType:dynamic,GuidType:guid,IntType:int,LongType:long,RealType:real,StringType:string,DecimalType:decimal)

allTypesDf.write.format("com.microsoft.kusto.spark.synapse.datasource").option("kustoDatabase", "e2e").option("kustoTable", "AllDataTypesTransactionalSpark34")
.option("tableCreateOptions","CreateIfNotExist").option("spark.synapse.linkedService", "sdkse2etestppe").mode("Append").save()
//allTypesDf.write.format("com.microsoft.kusto.spark.synapse.datasource").option("spark.synapse.linkedService", "sdkse2etestppe").option("kustoDatabase", "e2e").option("kustoTable", "AllDataTypesQueuedSpark33").option("tableCreateOptions","CreateIfNotExist").option("writeMode","Queued").mode("Append").save()

%%spark
val sip = new com.microsoft.kusto.spark.datasink. SparkIngestionProperties()
var ingestionTags = new java.util.ArrayList[String]()
ingestionTags.add("ICM-712785636")
sip.ingestByTags = ingestionTags

var dropTags = new java.util.ArrayList[String]()
dropTags.add("ICM-711105719")
sip.dropByTags = dropTags

val sipJson = sip.toString()

allTypesDf.write.format("com.microsoft.kusto.spark.synapse.datasource").option("kustoDatabase", "e2e").option("kustoTable", "AllDataTypesTransactionalSpark34V2")
.option("sparkIngestionPropertiesJson",sipJson).option("tableCreateOptions","CreateIfNotExist").option("spark.synapse.linkedService", "sdkse2etestppe").mode("Append").save()

# Read data from Azure Data Explorer table(s)
# Full Sample Code available at: https://github.com/Azure/azure-kusto-spark/blob/master/samples/src/main/python/SynapseSample.py
transactionalModeCount  = spark.read \
    .format("com.microsoft.kusto.spark.synapse.datasource") \
    .option("spark.synapse.linkedService", "sdkse2etestppe") \
    .option("kustoDatabase", "e2e") \
    .option("kustoQuery", "AllDataTypesTransactionalSpark34 | project DiffSecs = datetime_diff('second',ingestion_time(),todatetime(DateTimeType)) | summarize  count(),min(DiffSecs),max(DiffSecs),avg(DiffSecs)") \
    .load()

display(transactionalModeCount)
